<a id="active"></a>
## 🟢 可获取

阈值来自社区观察，并非完整官方规范。启用设置后，私有贡献也可能计入。

<a id="starstruck"></a>
### Starstruck

<img src="../assets/badges/starstruck-default.png" width="96" alt="Starstruck">

创建获得 **16 颗星**的仓库；更高等级取决于同一仓库的星数。

**等级:** 16 → 128 → 512 → 4096 (仓库星数).

[真实示例](https://github.com/torvalds?achievement=starstruck&tab=achievements) · [S21](https://github.com/torvalds?achievement=starstruck&tab=achievements) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="pull-shark"></a>
### Pull Shark

<img src="../assets/badges/pull-shark-default.png" width="96" alt="Pull Shark">

作为作者提交 **2 个已合并的 PR**。

**等级:** 2 → 16 → 128 → 1024 (作者的已合并 PR).

[真实示例](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=pull-shark&tab=achievements) · [S22](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=pull-shark&tab=achievements) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="pair-extraordinaire"></a>
### Pair Extraordinaire

<img src="../assets/badges/pair-extraordinaire-default.png" width="96" alt="Pair Extraordinaire">

在 **1 个已合并的 PR** 中共同编写提交，正确使用 `Co-authored-by`。

**等级:** 1 → 10 → 24 → 48 (共同编写的已合并 PR).

[真实示例](https://github.com/Rongronggg9?achievement=pair-extraordinaire&tab=achievements) · [S23](https://github.com/Rongronggg9?achievement=pair-extraordinaire&tab=achievements) · [S18](https://docs.github.com/en/pull-requests/committing-changes-to-your-project/creating-and-editing-commits/creating-a-commit-with-multiple-authors) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="galaxy-brain"></a>
### Galaxy Brain

<img src="../assets/badges/galaxy-brain-default.png" width="96" alt="Galaxy Brain">

在 Discussions 获得 **2 个被采纳的回答**。`github.com/orgs/community` 自 2024-02-06 起不再授予。

**等级:** 2 → 8 → 16 → 32 (已采纳回答).

[真实示例](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=galaxy-brain&tab=achievements) · [S24](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=galaxy-brain&tab=achievements) · [S06](https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/106536) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="quickdraw"></a>
### Quickdraw

<img src="../assets/badges/quickdraw-default.png" width="96" alt="Quickdraw">

在创建后 **5 分钟内**关闭 issue 或 PR。

[真实示例](https://github.com/Schweinepriester?achievement=quickdraw&tab=achievements) · [S25](https://github.com/Schweinepriester?achievement=quickdraw&tab=achievements) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

[真实示例](https://github.com/Schweinepriester?achievement=yolo&tab=achievements) · [S26](https://github.com/Schweinepriester?achievement=yolo&tab=achievements) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="retired"></a>
## 🕰️ 历史成就

活动已经结束；已授予的徽章可以保留，新贡献无法解锁。

<a id="arctic-code-vault-contributor"></a>
### Arctic Code Vault Contributor

<img src="../assets/badges/arctic-code-vault-contributor-default.png" width="96" alt="Arctic Code Vault Contributor">

为 **2020-02-02 Arctic Code Vault 快照**中的合格仓库贡献代码。快照已关闭。

[真实示例](https://github.com/JakubOleksy?achievement=arctic-code-vault-contributor&tab=achievements) · [S04](https://github.blog/open-source/maintainers/the-arctic-code-vault-starts-production-and-your-open-source-projects-are-being-archived/) · [S05](https://archiveprogram.github.com/)

<a id="mars-2020-contributor"></a>
### Mars 2020 Contributor

<img src="../assets/badges/mars-2020-contributor-default.png" width="96" alt="Mars 2020 Contributor">

为 **NASA/JPL Ingenuity** 使用的指定项目版本提交代码。活动已结束。

[真实示例](https://github.com/torvalds?achievement=mars-2020-contributor&tab=achievements) · [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) · [S02](https://github.blog/news-insights/company-news/open-source-goes-to-mars/)

## 🧪 实验中 / 已停用

GitHub 确认 2026 年 3 月的重新启用是错误；未公布正式开放日期。

<a id="highlights"></a>
## ✨ 个人资料标记

Highlights 是独立的项目或账号标记；是否可获得取决于对应项目。

| 名称 | 状态 | 条件 | 来源 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Pro** | 可获取 | 使用 GitHub Pro。 | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **Developer Program Member** | 可获取 | 加入 GitHub Developer Program 并使用 GitHub API 开发应用。 | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **Security Bug Bounty Hunter** | 可获取 | 通过漏洞赏金项目报告符合条件的 GitHub 安全漏洞。 | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) · [S20](https://bounty.github.com/) |
| **GitHub Campus Expert** | 可获取 | 参加 GitHub Campus Experts；请核查当前申请规则。 | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **Security Advisory Credit** | 可获取 | 在 GitHub Advisory Database 的已接受安全公告中获得贡献认可。 | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **GitHub Star** | 可获取 | 入选 GitHub Stars；仓库星数本身不能解锁该标记。 | [S16](https://stars.github.com/) |
| **Discussion answered** | 历史成就 | 历史上的 Discussions 已采纳回答标记；社区于 2022 年报告其被 Galaxy Brain 替代。 | [S14](https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/31629) |
